verbatim: As is shown in the picture above, 图画描述.
source_verbatim: As is shown in the picture above, 图画描述.
normalized: As is shown in the picture above, [PICTURE_DESCRIPTION].
template: As is shown in the picture above, [PICTURE_DESCRIPTION].

usage_constraints: 只用于图画或漫画作文。
逗号后必须接完整图画描述分句。
图表题不要使用 picture。

verbatim: The drawing on the left side provides us with a lively scene: several urban residents are exercising in a park.
source_verbatim: The drawing on the left side provides us with a lively scene: several urban residents are exercising in a park.
normalized: The drawing on the left side provides us with a lively scene: [PICTURE_DESCRIPTION].
template: The drawing on the [POSITION] side provides us with a lively scene: [PICTURE_DESCRIPTION].

usage_constraints: 仅用于双图或可明确左右位置的图画。
冒号后写完整场景，不接单个名词。
POSITION 只用 left/right。

verbatim: Referring to the statistics provided in the chart, 图表描述.
source_verbatim: Referring to the statistics provided in the chart, 图表描述.

template: The statistics provided in the [CHART_TYPE] show that [DATA_DESCRIPTION].

usage_constraints: 只用于有数据的图表。
show that 后必须是主谓完整的数据分句。
CHART_TYPE 可用 chart/bar chart/line chart/table。
correction_note: 将悬垂风险结构 Referring to... 改为明确主语 The statistics... show that...；原文只作来源追溯。

verbatim: The bar chart shows the distribution/composition of 主题词 at a glance, revealing a striking disparity in their preferences.
source_verbatim: The bar chart shows the distribution/composition of 主题词 at a glance, revealing a striking disparity in their preferences.
normalized: The bar chart shows the distribution of [TOPIC].
template: The bar chart shows the distribution of [TOPIC].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p26；仅批准简洁主干，未批准斜杠替换和无依据的 disparity 判断。
usage_constraints: 只用于柱状图。
TOPIC 使用名词短语。
若图中不是分布数据，改用其他图表描述。

verbatim: The pie chart highlights the dominance of 选项 in 整体, which overshadows all other components.
source_verbatim: The pie chart highlights the dominance of 选项 in 整体, which overshadows all other components.
normalized: The pie chart highlights the dominance of [CATEGORY] in [WHOLE].
template: The pie chart highlights the dominance of [CATEGORY] in [WHOLE].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p26；人工缩减掉 which 尾部，避免指代歧义，只保留清晰主句。
usage_constraints: 仅在一个类别确实明显最大时使用。
CATEGORY 必须属于 WHOLE。
若差距不显著，不使用 dominance。

verbatim: The health literacy level of Chinese residents increased gradually from 8.8% in 2012 to 11.58% in 2016.
source_verbatim: The health literacy level of Chinese residents increased gradually from 8.8% in 2012 to 11.58% in 2016.
normalized: [METRIC] increased gradually from [START_VALUE] in [START_YEAR] to [END_VALUE] in [END_YEAR].
template: [METRIC] increased [ADVERB] from [START_VALUE] in [START_YEAR] to [END_VALUE] in [END_YEAR].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p29；数值顺序与时态正确，可安全抽象为增长句。
usage_constraints: START_YEAR 必须早于 END_YEAR。
两个数值必须同单位、同口径。
ADVERB 要与实际变化幅度相符。

verbatim: The percentage of graduates who pursue further study was 34% in 2018, compared with 26.3% in 2013, showing an increase of 7.7%.
source_verbatim: The percentage of graduates who pursue further study was 34% in 2018, compared with 26.3% in 2013, showing an increase of 7.7%.
normalized: [METRIC] was [END_VALUE] in [END_YEAR], compared with [START_VALUE] in [START_YEAR], showing an increase of [CHANGE].
template: [METRIC] was [END_VALUE] in [END_YEAR], compared with [START_VALUE] in [START_YEAR], showing an increase of [CHANGE].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p29；采用前后值方向正确的 2019 英二示例。
usage_constraints: END_YEAR 必须晚于 START_YEAR。
CHANGE 必须按原数据复算。
百分比差通常写 percentage points，除非题面明确按百分比增幅。

verbatim: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of...
source_verbatim: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of...
normalized: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of [TOPIC].
template: Recent years have witnessed the [ADJECTIVE] development of [TOPIC].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p34；结构自然，限定为确有时间趋势的主题。
usage_constraints: TOPIC 使用名词短语。
只有数据或事实支持发展趋势时使用。
ADJECTIVE 不得夸大图表变化。

verbatim: It is apparent from the statistics that…
source_verbatim: It is apparent from the statistics that…
normalized: It is apparent from the statistics that [DATA_BASED_CLAIM].
template: It is apparent from the statistics that [DATA_BASED_CLAIM].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p34；保留 that 从句骨架，不批准空泛结论。
usage_constraints: that 后必须接完整分句。
结论必须能由图中数据直接支持。
没有统计数据时不要使用。

verbatim: This is not an uncommon scene/phenomenon/ situation in our life.
source_verbatim: This is not an uncommon scene/phenomenon/ situation in our life.
normalized: This is not an uncommon phenomenon in our lives.
template: This is not an uncommon phenomenon in [CONTEXT].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p35；只批准 phenomenon 单一版本，并将 our life 规范为 our lives。
usage_constraints: 只用于现实中确实常见的现象。
避免与 common/recurrent 重复堆叠。
CONTEXT 使用明确范围，如 modern society。

verbatim: Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart.
source_verbatim: Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart.
normalized: Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart.
template: Many factors contribute to [PHENOMENON_OR_TENDENCY].
review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p41；搭配 contribute to 自然且因果方向清楚。
usage_constraints: to 后接名词短语，不接动词原形。
后文应至少展开两个真实因素。
不要把相关性直接写成因果。

verbatim: It has become increasingly evident that...
source_verbatim: It has become increasingly evident that...
normalized: It has become increasingly evident that [CLAIM].
template: It has become increasingly evident that [CLAIM].

usage_constraints: that 后接完整分句。
CLAIM 需要后文论据支持。
不与 obviously/apparently 重复叠加。

verbatim: We must acknowledge the fact that...
source_verbatim: We must acknowledge the fact that...
normalized: We must acknowledge the fact that [CLAIM].
template: We must acknowledge the fact that [CLAIM].

usage_constraints: that 后必须是可证实或可论证的事实判断。
不用于纯个人偏好。

source_verbatim: Not only does participating in labor practice classes improve undergraduates' physical and mental health, but it also promotes social progress.

usage_constraints: SINGULAR_ACTIVITY 用单数名词或动名词短语。
前半句使用 does 后，谓语用原形。
it 必须明确指代同一活动，两个谓语保持平行。

verbatim: It is, therefore, imperative for us to adopt a discerning attitude, carefully weighing its merits against its demerits.

normalized: It is, therefore, imperative for us to adopt a discerning attitude, carefully weighing its merits against its demerits.

review_note: 人工回看大作文 PDF p63；句法自然，保留 merits/demerits 对称结构。
usage_constraints: 只用于确有利弊两面的议题。

verbatim: Let us believe that this is the first step toward a brighter future for all of us.

只在该行动确实是起点时使用 first step。
不把单一措施夸大为最终解决方案。

verbatim: There is no better time than now for us to take collective and decisive action to address this pressing issue.

template: There is no better time than now for [ACTOR] to take [ADJECTIVE] action to address [PRESSING_ISSUE].

usage_constraints: 只用于确实紧迫的议题。
action 通常作不可数名词。
避免与 immediately/urgent 等近义词过度堆叠。

正式投诉或紧急通知可直接进入主题，不强制使用。
